scope: Native Designer sizing of Home treatment image, stamps, details and Discover treatment
supersedes: The estimated image-height subtraction in home-treatment-image-snap.json. The existing image-top snap and its 2rem scroll margin remain unchanged.

structure.children: Original heading, followed by the original marked layout owner.
structure.retainedDirectChildren: Original image stage, stamp component, divider, detail component, CTA. Their element IDs, CMS bindings and runtime ownership are retained.

tdb-home-treatment-stage.note: Medium/small minimums are retained from the previous layout. The flex allocation supplies the actual image height from first layout.

nativeStyles.fixedRows: Stamp/detail tdb-treatment-bottom variants, divider and CTA have flex-shrink:0. CTA align-self:auto preserves left alignment at its existing focused-card width.

desktopStampImage.note: Replaces min(13.5vw,14svh) so short windows no longer squeeze stamps. Existing medium-and-below height:auto and aspect-ratio:4/3 remain.

overflow: When image minimum plus fixed rows and padding exceeds the viewport, min-height:min-content expands the group in normal flow. The CTA remains reachable and the following section stays below it.

verification.activation: At 1280x720 the native pre-init image height and post-init height were both 258.354px; group height remained 720px. All six treatment selections retained those dimensions and the CTA position. Phone slide change retained its 844px group and 369.240px image.
verification.ownership: One marked owner; original five direct child IDs verified. Existing arrow selection and CTA links work.
verification.runtime: No JavaScript changes, injected sizing CSS, post-load height writes or external CSS changes.
verification.limits: Chromium responsive verification; physical Safari review is separate. Dimension checks do not constitute a whole-page CLS score.
